title: Tools
loading: Reading the tools on this computer…
catalogueFailed: Couldn't read the tools on this computer.
gone: “{{name}}” is no longer in the list. It may have been renamed or deleted.
noRealm: Choose one realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square) to change this agent's tools.
strict.where: Strict is set in the agent's file.
base.default: Hoody gives this agent its default tools, which aren't listed here.
base.every: This agent gets every tool, also ones added later.
search.placeholder: Search by name, ID or description…
group.otherNote: Names in this file that aren't tools of this computer's agent. Untick one to drop it; it can't be added back here.
scope.agents: Helpers, tasks, questions and agent files
scope.web: Web pages, web search and images
scope.todos: This chat's checklist and the todo board
scope.automation: Workflows, hooks, tool scripts and schedules
scope.memory: Saved memory, recall and past chats
scope.fleet: Computers, snapshots, access, scripts and programs
scope.more: Tools this page can't sort into a group yet
group.title: {{group}} · {{count}}
summary.same: No tick changed, but saving writes “no tools” in place of Hoody's default tools.
every.title: Give {{name}} every tool?
every.body: Nothing is ticked and strict is off, so saving removes the list: {{name}} gets every tool, also later ones. For no tools, turn strict on first.
readFirst: Nothing was saved: the agents list couldn't be read first. Try again.
changed: Nothing was saved: this agent's tools changed since you opened them. Load the current list and tick again.
changedBand: This agent's tools changed since you started ticking.
goneAtSave: Nothing was saved: this agent is no longer in the list.
savedUnread: Saved. {{name}}'s tools couldn't be read again, so they aren't shown yet. Try again reads them.
savedOther: Saved, but {{name}} now reports other tools ({{words}}): they changed again elsewhere.
held: The save of {{name}}'s tools may have gone through. Check again reads the agents list; nothing is sent again.
heldElsewhere: A save of {{name}}'s tools from another page may have gone through. Check it there.
stop.title: Stop tracking this save?
stop.body: It may still have gone through. The ticks unlock, and the list shows what the agent reports when it is read again.
refused: The agent didn't take this list, so nothing was written.
leave.title: Leave without saving the tools?
leave.body: Your ticks for {{name}} are not saved.
chat.line: In New chat, Just chat now reads: “{{line}}”
reach.none: Answers in the chat. No tools: it cannot read files or run commands.
reach.read: Can read and search files on {{computer}}; changes nothing.
reach.acts: Reads and edits files, runs commands and starts helpers on {{computer}}, as you.
why.q: How does this tool list work?
why.strict: Strict is on: the agent gets exactly the ticked tools, and saving with none ticked gives it no tools at all.
why.base: Strict is off: the ticked tools are a base Hoody adds to; saving with none ticked gives it every tool.
acts.allOff.aria: Turn off every tool shown that can change things ({{count}} on now)
acts.noneOn: None of these tools is on.
